Filing-gate category ③ — the maintainer's order in the dispatching session, verbatim: 「测试遇到的问题，可以提交issue」. This is the **family card** for checklist-accuracy fails from that browser pass (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104 Half 2): each row below is a `fail` whose disposition is *stale spec* (the product follows a later ruling the clause predates) or *assertion defect* (the clause is wrong about intended behaviour). The product side of each is correct, so no product card is owed for these rows. Later rows from the same pass are appended as comments here, never as single-point cards.

**Reader who acts:** whichever seat owns `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` edits (revise the item, bump `revision`, append `history`, keep `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` green). **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "platform checklist items stale clause re-point assertion defect checklist item revision after ruling" — no open card collects these.

Subject of the pass: objectstack `36b2889c` + `.objectui-sha` set locally to `1fb1ced36243` (equivalent to PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23110's head), stock `examples/app-showcase`. Each row was reproduced on two fresh loads by its runner.

| QA-source | disposition | what the clause pins | what the product does, and why that is right |
|---|---|---|---|
| `#23104 · platform-core.home-admin-cluster-links · A2` (rev 2) | stale spec | legacy `system/roles`, `system/positions`, `system/permissions` URLs land on the `sys_position` / `sys_permission_set` object routes | they land on the Setup metadata catalog (`/apps/setup/metadata/position?scope=environment`, `…/metadata/permission?scope=environment`); objectui `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx` routes them to `SystemCatalogRedirect` since objectui#7611 (positions and permission sets are registry items, ADR-0131 D3). `users` and `organizations` still match. Re-point the three. |
| `#23104 · identity-auth.auth-method-matrix · A9` (rev 6) | assertion defect | `delete-user` answers 404 "to every caller, authed or not" | anonymous `POST /api/v1/auth/delete-user` → 401 `UNAUTHORIZED`, authed → 404; `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/change-email-delete-user-wiring.test.ts` pins exactly that (anonymous 401: mounted and session-guarded). No caller gets 2xx. Re-word: authed 404 (capability switch), anonymous 401 (session guard), never 2xx. |
| `#23104 · identity-auth.self-signup-gate · N5` (rev 2) | stale spec | under stock `invite_only` the login page offers the register link and `/register` renders the form | no register link; `/register` renders the by-invitation notice with no form, and the form appears for an `/accept-invitation/ID` redirect (verified) or a zero-owner deployment — objectui `RegisterPage.tsx` / `signUpOffer.ts` since objectui#11691 / objectui#11705. Re-point step 0 and the negative to that rule. |
| `#23104 · access-security.owd-save-gate · A3` (rev 3) | stale spec | widening a packaged object's OWD answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with `declaredCode: owd_widening_forbidden` from the plugin-security R1 gate | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` from the ADR-0131 D6 managed-content seal (`e02833c24`, #22401), which now answers before the R1 gate, so `owd_widening_forbidden` is unreachable on stock; the protection holds. Re-point to the seal, or to a writable-package widening probe if R1 still needs a live oracle. |
